4854:soul:2043.reviewedBy: Codex explicit current self alive contribution and actual team dependency source review
4854:soul:2043.rationale: 当前自身是背包中实际存活的一只，5%红减与属性命中50点固定吸取立即实现，不虚构其他成员。只有其他存活成员贡献与明确己方存在图特摩斯条件延期。原API格式化明确攻击伤害，未机械减免固粉真。
4854:soul:2043.singleBehavior: 当前自身存活5%红减；属性命中固定吸取50并理论回复；受到正完整红不高300时，已中毒改固定吸取300，否则100%中毒，零红和死亡不触发；魂印回血独立于技能禁疗。

success.name: 4854真实2043当前自身存活贡献5%只减红，属性命中固定吸取50与理论回复，整招无效不触发
success.assertion:
const a=make({move:10062,index:-1,soul:true}),base=make({move:10062,index:-1});const n=[];observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)for(const type of['fixed','percent','true'])n.push(c.hurt(c.t,100,'非红通道',type));},()=>turn(a,10062,10127));turn(base,10062,10127);assert.ok(Math.abs(sum(a,'attack',1)-sum(base,'attack',1)*.95)<=1);assert.deepEqual(n,[100,100,100]);
 const b=make({move:20249,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1000});timer(b,1,'固定百分比免疫');turn(b);assert.equal(b.fighters[0].hp,1050);assert.equal(sum(b,'fixed'),0);const c=make({move:20249,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1000});turn(c);assert.equal(c.fighters[0].hp,1050);assert.equal(sum(c,'fixed'),50);const d=make({move:20249,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1000});timer(d,0,'skillBlock');turn(d);assert.equal(d.fighters[0].hp,1000);assert.equal(sum(d,'fixed'),0);

success.name: 4854真实2043完整红299及300中毒、301不触发，已有中毒改固定吸取300，免伤0不触发
success.assertion:
for(const amount of[299,300,301]){const a=make({move:10062,index:-1,soul:true,bStats:{atk:9999}});timer(a,0,'攻击伤害上限',{amount});turn(a,10062,10127);assert.equal(sum(a,'attack',1),amount);assert.equal(!!a.fighters[1].ailments['中毒'],amount<=300);assert.equal(sum(a,'fixed'),0);}
 const b=make({move:10062,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1000});b.fighters[1].ailments['中毒']=4;turn(b,10062,10127);assert.equal(sum(b,'fixed'),300);assert.equal(b.fighters[0].hp,1000-sum(b,'attack',1)+300);const immune=make({move:10062,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1000});immune.fighters[1].ailments['中毒']=4;timer(immune,1,'固定百分比免疫');turn(immune,10062,10127);assert.equal(sum(immune,'fixed'),0);assert.equal(immune.fighters[0].hp,1000-sum(immune,'attack',1)+300);const zero=make({move:10062,index:-1,soul:true});timer(zero,0,'攻击伤害免疫');turn(zero,10062,10127);assert.equal(zero.fighters[1].ailments['中毒'],undefined);

success.name: 4854魂印吸取回血不受技能禁疗，属性命中封锁只封技能效果；死亡不触发受击中毒或吸取复活
success.assertion:
const a=make({move:20249,soul:true,hp:1000});timer(a,0,'技能禁疗');timer(a,0,'属性技能命中效果失效');turn(a);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].stages.spe,0);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].hp,1050);assert.equal(sum(a,'fixed'),50);
 const b=make({move:10062,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1});turn(b,10062,10127);assert.equal(b.fighters[0].hp,0);assert.equal(b.fighters[1].ailments['中毒'],undefined);assert.equal(sum(b,'fixed'),0);
